case.title: Enumerator point about 5.6 m inside both the west and south edges of Kondele

submissions.open_text: Pipe in the compound runs only three days a week.
Handcart sellers raised prices after the rains stopped.

case.why: 34.76005 is 0.00005 deg east of the west edge 34.76 and -0.08995 is 0.00005 deg north of the south edge -0.09, so the point is inside Kondele about 5.6 m from each edge. An implementation that treats the north edge -0.07 as the lower bound for negative latitudes, swaps lat and lng when testing the (lng, lat) rectangle, or shrinks the polygon by a tolerance would wrongly fire. Other checks quiet: 2 submissions 3h20 apart, distinct texts, 24-27 min durations, daytime, single device per contributor, no transcripts.
